name: open-shopping-agent
description: Search Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Best Buy, Target and Shopify stores at once, compare, fill carts and check out only with your approval of the exact total. MCP server plus a skill with the safety rules. Placing orders stays off unless OSA_MCP_ALLOW_ORDERS=1.

browsa_api_key.title: Browsa API key (optional)
browsa_api_key.description: Runs each store on a Phantom cloud browser (browsa.io). Leave empty to use your own Chrome on this computer.
